Titel: Head of Controlling (f/m/d)
Unternehmen: Brightfell Medical GmbH
Ort: Berlin (Deutschland)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187020561/
Abgerufen am: 17.09.2026 07:30

About us
Brightfell Medical develops and manufactures diagnostic devices for hospitals across Europe. With 600 employees and strong growth, we are building a finance organisation that can scale with us.

The role
As Head of Controlling you report directly to the CFO and lead a team of six controllers. You own planning, forecasting and management reporting for the whole company.

What you will do
- Lead the annual budgeting and the rolling forecast process
- Build a KPI framework and management reporting in Power BI
- Business partnering with sales, operations and R&D
- Drive cost center and product profitability analysis
- Support the CFO in board and investor communication

What you bring
- 10+ years of experience in controlling, at least 3 years in a leadership role
- Experience in a medtech or life sciences company
- Strong skills in SAP CO and Power BI
- Fluent German and English

What we offer
- Permanent full-time position (40 hours per week)
- Annual gross salary of 120,000 to 140,000 EUR plus bonus
- 30 days of vacation and a company pension scheme
- Hybrid work with 2 remote days per week
